messages.author: ad1a6abcb84542f8
messages.subject: map not sowing in computers inside a corporate network
parts:
Hello everyone,

We have deployed a test version of an app in shinyapps. The application works correctly in our web explorer but not in a client's network. There, the application takes a lot more time to run and, on top, maps using rCharts library are not showing (they appear gray). The rest of the app works correctly (simple graphs and graphs using rCharts). Could this be a problem with proxy configuration when downloading the map? The maps come from Open Street Maps.

Has anybody seen this problem / something similar or suspects what can be going wrong?

thanks,

Franco
